quote: Anthropic announced the general release of Claude Fable 5 on June 9, 2026, a 'Mythos-class' model made available for general use with a set of safeguards.
note: Claude Fable 5 was temporarily restricted on June 12, 2026 due to US export controls, then redeployed starting July 1, 2026. Claude Fable 5.1 was released on September 1, 2026.
